meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first: who decided that, and on what basis?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. Start with the zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for how he found out, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She never left her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on his record, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended after two exchanges.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence was put in front of her before the meeting ended.
What cost ground: Opening with a thank-you instead of answering her question about who decided, which told a litigator you had nothing ready and let her keep control of the agenda.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was presented; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and on what basis, own in one sentence that the zero went in before her call, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her that she can check herself.
